edges.reason: onlyCFO gates toLotteryPool with require(msg.sender == dogCore.cfoAddress()).
onlyCEO gates setFinalLotteryAddress with require(msg.sender == dogCore.ceoAddress()).
setLotteryDuration requires msg.sender == dogCore.ceoAddress().
registerLottery requires address(dogCore) == msg.sender, trusting the caller identity.
rewardLottery requires msg.sender == finalLottery, a mutable state address.
toSPool requires msg.sender == finalLottery before mutating SpoolAmount.
random() sets randomSeed = block.timestamp, making the draw miner-influenceable.
random2() hashes block.timestamp into keccak256, a timestamp-dependency weakness.
random() derives its result from keccak256(randomSeed, block.difficulty).
random2() derives its result from keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty).
openLottery consumes the value produced by random() as luckyNum.
random2() result becomes luckyDog inside _getValidRandomGenes.
openCarousel receives the genes returned by _getValidRandomGenes.
_validGenes output drives the oscillation loop in _getValidRandomGenes.
distributeLottery calls external dogCore.sendMoney before the term state is finalised.
The external sendMoney transfer can re-enter distributeLottery while payouts are in progress.
The finalLottery state address is the only allowed caller of rewardLottery.
SpoolAmount feeds the unchecked subtraction performed in toLotteryPool.
SpoolAmount -= amount inside toLotteryPool can underflow without SafeMath.
bonusPool.balance is used in the unchecked subtractions of distributeLottery.
totalAmount - SpoolAmount and balance - SpoolAmount computed with unchecked arithmetic.
_validGenes queries dogCore for ownership, generation and variation.
getDog returns the tuple destructured inside _validGenes.
ownerOf is used by _validGenes to reject finalLottery-owned dogs.
duration bounds the redemption window checked in registerLottery.
duration bounds the payout time window checked in distributeLottery.
openLottery reads and pushes CLotteries entries while advancing the term.
currentGene selects branches and updates the draw pointer in openLottery.
lastBlockNumber is compared and rewritten by openLottery.
randomSeed is overwritten inside random() on every draw.
registerLottery pulls luckyGenes, totalAmount, openBlock, isReward and term from getCLottery.
distributeLottery pulls the term record from lotteryCore.getCLottery.
convertGeneArray expands dog genes for comparison in getLotteryClass.
convertGene packs lucky genes for the OpenCarousel event in openCarousel.
getLotteryClass result gates whether registerLottery accepts a dog.
checkLottery delegates the class computation to getLotteryClass.
openLottery reverts when _isCarousal reports a guaranteed term.
openCarousel requires _isCarousal to be true before drawing.
distributeLottery selects carousel or normal ratios via _isCarousal.
_getLuckyList supplies winners and dog ids to the payout loop.
_pushLuckyInfo stores the winner entry recorded by registerLottery.
_getGen0Address resolves the gen0 owner paid alongside main prizes.
openCarousel records bonusPool.balance as the term totalAmount.
distributeLottery calls lotteryCore.toSPool when no first prize was claimed.
distributeLottery finalises the term through lotteryCore.rewardLottery.
SpoolAmount += amount in toSPool is unchecked and can overflow.
checkLottery reads current lucky genes from getCLottery before grading.
block.timestamp participates in payout timing windows that gate ratio selection.
_getLuckyList reads the same flotteries arrays that _pushLuckyInfo appends to.

Parameter only updates duration under the CEO access check.
Temporary holder for the draw result produced by random().
Temporary term cursor derived from CLotteries.length used only in openLottery.
Accumulator local returned by the search loop inside _getValidRandomGenes.
